scenario: AITA for not wanting my daughter to get a nose job | My ex and I are supposed to make medical decisions together and split the cost. My ex told me that this will be pursued in court and called me an ass for not prioritizing my daughters needs. AITA for not wanting my daughter to get cosmetic surgery at 16?
